title: tfpr PlanResult v1
description: What tfpr plan or tfpr derive hands every later stage (plan-result.json in the plan dir). A run of N units; plain terraform is one unit at path ".". It never contains attribute values. Adding fields keeps @1; renaming, removing or changing the meaning of a field bumps to @2.

runner.description: byo: the caller ran terraform and tfpr derive read its output

stack.description: normalized root dir: the terraform stack or the terragrunt root

key.description: slug(stack):workspace; one PR comment and one artifact per key

sha.description: the commit checked out and planned; on PR builds the merge commit (GITHUB_SHA, Build.SourceVersion); empty when the CI did not say

head_sha.description: PR builds: the PR's head commit (the event's pull_request.head.sha, System.PullRequest.SourceCommitId); empty otherwise

attempt.description: 0 = the CI has no attempt counter

exit_code.description: computed from units: 1 if any unit is error or not_run, else 2 if any is not no_op, else 0

sha256.description: hex sha256 over the sorted lines "<path> <planfile sha256>\n" of every unit with a planfile; absent when no unit has one

mode.description: filter: TFPR_FILTER ran over the plan text and over the resource addresses and output names copied from plan.json. none: no filter ran, so those names are as plan.json had them (a caller's own scrubber over plan.txt does not cover them). byo is reserved for a caller that hands tfpr names it has already filtered; tfpr does not write it today

render.description: written by render; absent before it

status.description: error: exit 1. changes: any create/update/delete/replace, or exit 2 with nothing tfpr can count. state_only: only import/forget/move. outputs_only: only output changes. no_op: nothing to apply. not_run: skipped because an upstream unit failed. excluded: removed by an exclude block

path.description: relative to target.stack, as the runner names it; "." for plain terraform

exit_code.description: the unit's -detailed-exitcode; null when the caller did not say

resources.description: resource changes in plan.json order, no-ops omitted; names pass through TFPR_FILTER when one is configured

forget.description: the old object is forgotten, not destroyed: actions [forget, create], counted as a create and a forget

outputs.description: changed root outputs, sorted by name, without values

drift.description: len(resource_drift); shown, never counted as a change

text_chars.description: characters in the filtered plan text; null when the runner could not attribute text to this unit

fingerprint.description: sha256:<hex> of the unit's filtered plan text

sha256.description: hex sha256 of the binary planfile

dependencies.description: direct upstream units as root-relative paths; [] for terraform

state_empty.description: the plan's prior state has no resources

provisional.description: the plan depends on upstream state this run may change

skippable.description: status is no_op and the unit is not provisional

error.description: why a unit with status error has no plan (the plan failed, or its output was missing or invalid)
